sloka: अनेन हि महाराज महेश्वरमनुत्तमम् ।इष्ट्वा यज्ञम् वरो लब्धो लोके परमदुर्लभः ॥६-७-१९॥।।
transliteration: anena hi mahārāja maheśvaramanuttamam ।iṣṭvā yajñam varo labdho loke paramadurlabhaḥ ॥6-7-19॥।।

translations.english: "Raghava is not equal to them in valour, excellence and energy. Those warriors who were difficult to overcome by battle were overpowered and killed by you."
